messages:
anya: Quick planning thread — staging rollout for routing + model-variant fallback. Proposal: staged regional warm-up with "safety sails" (auto-reduce traffic + fallback to model-legacy) if p95 latency > 400ms or error rate > 0.5%. Looking for launch criteria, ramp cadence, and who owns what. TL;DR: 6-step regional warm-up, A/B quality check, explicit kill-pill path.

devon: +1 to warm-up. My suggested ramp: 2% → 8% → 20% → 50% → 80% → 100%. Steps 1–4 = 30m each; step 5 = 2h; step 6 = 4h. Auto-ramp only if both p95 and error rate are within thresholds for the last 10m. Fail-fast: immediate tilt back to previous slice on >0.7% errors within 5m.

matt: Fallback variants we should create: `model-legacy` (current prod), `model-safe` (quantized but quality-tested). Fallback policy idea: when triggered, route 100% to fallback in region for 10m, then attempt 30% original variant for 15m; if metrics stable, continue ramp, else hold and page. Need to preserve KV cache TTL to avoid cold-start regressions when switching back. Also propose a manual `kill-pill` route that sends traffic to cheapest artifact + returns a clear incident playbook link.

sara: Observability checklist: per-region + per-variant dashboard, heatmap for p50/p95/p99, token-cost per req, 5-min error rate. SLIs: p95 latency (ms), 5-min error rate (%), downstream 429/503 ratio. Alerting: page on region p95 > 450ms AND error > 1% for 5m. For A/B quality we run golden prompt set and measure acceptance-rate; need ~2k samples per arm for 95% power on small effect sizes.

leila: On stats: we'll run two-sided bootstrap + chi2 for categorical metrics. Significance threshold p < 0.05 and require minimum absolute lift of 1.5% on quality metric to consider rollout. For automated gating: both infra SLIs and quality tests must pass for last 30m window.

devon: Example flag config (prototype):
```json
{
  "flag": "regional-warmup-routing",
  "regions": ["us-west-2","eu-west-1","ap-northeast-1"],
  "steps": [
    {"pct": 2, "duration_min": 30},
    {"pct": 8, "duration_min": 30},
    {"pct": 20, "duration_min": 30},
    {"pct": 50, "duration_min": 30},
    {"pct": 80, "duration_min": 120},
    {"pct": 100, "duration_min": 240}
  ],
  "safety": {
    "p95_latency_ms": 400,
    "error_rate_pct": 0.5,
    "auto_revert_window_min": 5
  },
  "fallback": "model-legacy"
}
```

devon: For rollout order: start in low-traffic region (us-west-2), then eu-west-1, then ap-northeast-1. Stagger region starts by 60m so we can watch heatmap and avoid correlated failures.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started warm-up: region=eu-west-1 step=1 pct=2 at ts=2398765440. Flags applied to 2% traffic slice.

incidents-bot: incidents-bot: If `kill-pill` triggered, notify #incidents and auto-create P0 if more than 3 regions fail the safety gates within 30m. Also post rollout metadata to incident ticket (flag, commit, owner).

anya: Ops + product decision checklist:
- Launch criteria: all regions p95 < 400ms, error < 0.5% and A/B quality p<0.05 on golden prompts for 30m window.
- Rollback policy: immediate revert to `model-legacy` per-region on safety violation. Full org rollback only if >2 regions in fail state for 30m.
- Manual overrides: shipops can trigger `kill-pill` which routes to `model-legacy` and pages SRE.

anya: Action items:
- devon -> add final flag JSON + open PR (include staged start times per region).
- sara -> build per-variant dashboards + golden prompts job.
- leila -> write stats harness + automated checks for quality gating.
- matt -> draft fallback lambda and cache migration notes.

anya: Target: PR + dashboards green by EOD Fri, aim to start warm-up next Tue if nothing blocks. Tagging owners: @devon @sara @leila @matt. :rocket:

devon: I'll put the flag PR up today and add runbook snippets for manual rollback.

sara: I'll spin up a quick dashboard and post the link in this thread when ready.

leila: I'll add the test harness to infra-evals and share run commands.

matt: Drafting fallback lambda now — will include cache warm rehydrate steps and TTL notes.

anya: Great. If anyone thinks the ramp percentages/durations are too aggressive, shout now. Otherwise I'll capture this in the rollout doc and attach the PRs.

matt: Fine with numbers but pls add a cooldown check before any cross-region ramp (10m).

anya: Added cooldown note. OK closing thread for action tracking — will link PRs here. Thanks everyone.
